title: Ban appeal

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Heey ReeseyRages99,

Ban Evading means using an alternate/other account to play on a server while your account is banned.
It's not allowed since you broke a rule and you should server your time punished and learn that your behavior isn't appropriate on Avicus.
The staff member that banned you has been notified of your appeal.

Regards Flo/resepignev

replies.author: ReeceyRages99
replies.body: So i was banned on ReeceyRages99 a year ago and did not ban evade at all during that year, after the year i decided to appeal for the ban of using hacks (which i did not.)  The mod decided to appeal me after checking my ip and knowing that i did not ban evaded (he told me this in the appeal.)  I was back on the server having so much fun like i was before however soon after people were msg me saying things like you are linux saying i was ban evading, as i was not i ignored this but i was banned in the next 5 days for ban evading and i had no idea how.  I decided to appeal again as i thought it was a mistake as the previous mod had even ip checked me and seen  i had not ban evaded.  In the second appeal the mods told me when i was ip checked my ban evaded accounts were not showing but all of a sudden they did.  I questioned this i had not ever ban evaded and i didnt even know how this was possible or what was happening? I asked the mods several times if they can explain this and they gave me very little information and finally decided not to reply after i had left several messages (this is not what mods should be like.)  I know i have never ban evaded despite what people say, and if the mods can explain what happened this would be good as i am confused also any evidence wanted i will try my best to give thanks for looking at my appeal

Heeya ReeceyRages99,

Since you were that kind to tell me that you are ban evading, I've requested an ipcheck for your account. Luckily enough it showed that you were in fact evading your ban.
Since you did it in such excessive manner and you also threatened to continue, this appeal is denied and you'll not have any chance to appeal any time soon or ever again.

Regards Flo/resepignev :D
